title: Trace a Done story’s timing history into test Proof

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The existing test protects the selected Done landing’s exact timing-history endpoint against a later publication with the same story identity.

Story: `SEED-285#trace-landed-proof-timing`, Scope “Cohort and endpoint” and Key example 7, at revision `c83bb626af3bb25bab263875d98cdfa34593200b` (`.planning/seeds/SEED-285-landed-ci-timing-history.md:80` and `:169`).

The isolated scratch checkout used that exact revision. The existing MakeMe fixture in `tests/support/intent-ci-scope-history.test.mjs:6` creates three same-identity landings with 1,200 ms, selected 0 ms, and later 9,900 ms proof. Its independent `assert.deepEqual` at line 88 requires only the first two points, with the middle landing marked selected.

Temporary production fault: in `dashboard/server/ciScopeHistory.ts:33`, replace `positions.get(endpoint.revision)` with `order === undefined ? undefined : order.length - 1`. This incorrectly cuts the cohort at the newest ordered landing rather than the published Done endpoint. Neither fixture nor assertion changed.

All three runs used the maintained focused command, with Homebrew Bash first on PATH and AC sleep protection:

```sh
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH caffeinate -s -i npm test -- tests/support/intent-ci-scope-history.test.mjs
```

Baseline passed (exit 0). The fault run failed (exit 1) at the intended line-88 assertion: actual history contained an extra `{ kind: "point", ms: 9900, marked: false }`, while the expected history still ended at the selected zero point. This observed wrong cohort proves the changed endpoint reached the protected behavior. Restored run passed (exit 0).

Restoration matched production and fixture SHA-256 hashes and the scratch pre-probe status exactly. The setup-only dependency symlink was then removed, the scratch tree verified clean, and its owned worktree and branch safely removed. The execution checkout was untouched. Logs, timing/outcome files, fault patch, hashes and retirement evidence remain under `/private/var/folders/65/16p4k5qj42qg7l46k2j0nhj40000gn/T/trace285-intent-coverage-1yez9n7b/`. The report is saved verbatim at `/tmp/trace-proof-285-intent-coverage-report.md`.
